Title: Generally Available: New regions for Azure Functions Flex consumption

Body.Content:
Beyond the already generally available regions, you can now create Flex Consumption apps in the following regions: 

  • Australia Southeast  
  • Brazil South 
  • Canada Central 
  • Central India 
  • Central US 
  • France Central 
  • Germany West Central 
  • Italy North 
  • Japan East 
  • Korea Central  
  • North Central US 
  • Norway East 
  • South Africa North 
  • South India 
  • Spain Central  
  • UAE North 
  • Uk West 
  • West Central US 
  • West Europe 
  • West US 

 

Pricing for each region will be available by July 1st.
Learn more.
